key.name: refresh-interval
key.description: How often to poll the Claude usage endpoint.

key.name: credentials-path
key.description: Path to Claude Code's credentials JSON. Empty uses ~/.claude/.credentials.json.

key.name: show-panel-percentages
key.summary: Show usage percentages in the top bar
key.description: When enabled, compact per-limit percentages appear next to the panel icon (e.g. "S 15% · W 28% · F 26%": S = current session, W = weekly all models, other letters = per-model weekly limits). When disabled, only the icon is shown.

key.name: show-pace
key.description: When enabled, each limit shows the usage expected by now if its window (5 hours for the session, 7 days for weekly limits) were used at a steady rate, and turns yellow when actual usage is 10 or more points above it. The weekly pace assumes round-the-clock use, so working only on weekdays reads as ahead in the first working days after the weekly reset.
